mechanism_claims.claim_text: IsCT and E7K-IsCT are supported as membrane-interacting/damaging antibacterial peptides in this paper, based on lipid-vesicle permeabilization, hRBC membrane-damage, bacterial PI staining, and SEM/localization evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The final record keeps this as paper-specific mechanism evidence, not a universal mechanism for all IsCT analogs.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: I9K-IsCT and E7K,I9K-IsCT are supported as translocating into bacterial cytoplasm without strong membrane perturbation in the paper-local evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact intracellular concentration is not extracted from figures; qualitative localization is source-supported.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: I9K-IsCT and E7K,I9K-IsCT inhibit DNA, RNA, and protein synthesis in E. coli ATCC 25922 in the source-described radioactive precursor incorporation assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: I9K-IsCT and E7K,I9K-IsCT against Escherichia coli ATCC 25922
